title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 8
subtitle: The Best Barbecue
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 8: The Best Barbecue (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for meeting me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你来见我。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Sure.
dialogue.zh: 当然。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d like to get your advice on my latest project.
dialogue.zh: 我想听听你对我最新项目的建议。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Of course. I heard you were sent to cover a big food festival that has all kinds of barbecue. So, how did it go?
dialogue.zh: 当然。我听说你被派去报道一个有各种烧烤的大型美食节。怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, things started out great! But then, well, maybe you should watch it yourself.
dialogue.zh: 一开始挺顺利！可后来……也许你自己看吧。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hi English learners! Your lesson today is about my favorite food -- barbecue! Your assignment is to find passive sentences. What are those, you might ask? In passive sentences the subject receives the action! For example, “Anna was sent to cover a food festival.” Passive sentences have a form of the BE verb + the past participle of the main verb. This lesson is LOADED with passive sentences. Hey! That’s a passive sentence, too! Okay, now, it’s Barbecue Time!
dialogue.zh: 英语学习者你们好！今天这一课是我最爱的食物——烧烤！你的任务是找出被动句。被动句里，主语是动作的承受者！例如：“Anna was sent to cover a food festival.” 被动句用 be 动词加上主要动词的过去分词。这一课装满了被动句。嘿！这也是被动句！好，现在是烧烤时间！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held in Washington, D.C. This festival, which is known as one of the biggest food festivals in the United States, brings together barbecue lovers from all over the country! Barbecue is meat that is cooked over an open fire or on a grill.
dialogue.zh: 今天，华盛顿特区正在举办烧烤大战。这个节日被称为美国最大的美食节之一，把全国的烧烤爱好者聚在一起！烧烤是在明火上或烤架上烹制的肉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Chicken, pork and beef are all common meats to grill on a barbecue! No matter which meat you like to barbecue, the sauce is very important. Sauces are taken very seriously by chefs. Most ingredients are kept secret!
dialogue.zh: 鸡肉、猪肉和牛肉都是常见的烧烤肉！不管你爱烤哪种肉，酱汁都非常重要。厨师对待酱汁非常认真。大多数配料都是保密的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, can you tell us what is in your barbecue sauce?
dialogue.zh: 那你能告诉我们你的烧烤酱里有什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Chef 1
dialogue.en: No, I can’t tell you.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不能告诉你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, tell us, what is the secret ingredient in your barbecue sauce?
dialogue.zh: 那告诉我们，你烧烤酱里的秘密配料是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Chef 2
dialogue.en: (says nothing.)
dialogue.zh: （什么也不说。）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sauces are made by the barbecue chefs themselves. Most sauces are made with a tomato sauce, vinegar, and spices.
dialogue.zh: 酱汁是烧烤厨师自己做的。大多数酱汁用番茄酱、醋和香料做成。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: How many passive sentences did you find? Here is one I found: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. Now you try. Turn this sentence from active to passive. Professor Bot loves Barbecue! Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot. Good job! And yes, I do.
dialogue.zh: 你找到多少被动句了？我找到一句：Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. 现在你来试试。把这句从主动变成被动。Professor Bot loves Barbecue! Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot. 干得好！没错，我就是爱烧烤。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are some areas of the U.S. that are known for their tasty barbecue. The states of Texas, North and South Carolina and the cities of Memphis and Kansas City are known as the Barbecue Belt.
dialogue.zh: 美国有些地方以美味烧烤闻名。得克萨斯州、北卡和南卡，以及孟菲斯和堪萨斯城，被称为烧烤带。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People who are loyal to barbecue are really loyal to their favorite barbecue. That is why this festival is called a battle! Let’s ask a couple of people which barbecue is best.
dialogue.zh: 对烧烤忠实的人，对自己最爱的烧烤也特别忠实。所以这个节日才叫大战！我们问问几个人哪种烧烤最好。

dialogue.speaker: Person 1
dialogue.en: Texas, of course!
dialogue.zh: 当然是得州！

dialogue.speaker: Person 2
dialogue.en: Carolina barbecue is the very best.
dialogue.zh: 卡罗来纳烧烤才是最好的。

dialogue.speaker: Person 3
dialogue.en: Kansas City!
dialogue.zh: 堪萨斯城！

dialogue.speaker: Person 4
dialogue.en: Memphis style!
dialogue.zh: 孟菲斯风味！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is Anna Matteo reporting.
dialogue.zh: 这里是安娜·马特奥报道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Kelly, people feel so strongly about barbecue. Unbelievable! So, what do you think of my project?
dialogue.zh: 凯莉，人们对烧烤的感情也太强烈了。难以置信！那你觉得我的项目怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: This is what I think. There is no way that Texas has the best barbecue. I am from Kansas City and we have THE best barbecue in the whole country. My mother and father owned a barbecue restaurant, which was really famous! So, I know barbecue! Anna, I know barbecue! I know barbecue! I know barbecue!
dialogue.zh: 我是这么想的。得州绝不可能有最好的烧烤。我来自堪萨斯城，我们才有全国最好的烧烤。我爸妈开过一家烧烤店，非常有名！所以我懂烧烤！安娜，我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh my. Kelly knows a lot about barbecue! And you know more about passive sentences! Be sure you go to the website to learn even more! Ah! Now, if you'll excuse me .. I'm hungry.
dialogue.zh: 天哪。凯莉对烧烤很懂！你对被动句也更懂了！一定要去网站再学更多！啊！失陪一下……我饿了。

choices: A pet contest at the state fair
A tour of the Lincoln Memorial

quiz.prompt: What do the chefs keep secret?
choices: The ingredients in their barbecue sauce

quiz.prompt: Which barbecue does Kelly say is the best?
